meta.name: anndata
meta.description: Data structure for annotated matrices in single-cell analysis. Use when working with .h5ad files or integrating with the scverse ecosystem. This is the data format skill—for analysis workflows use scanpy; for probabilistic models use scvi-tools; for population-scale queries use cellxgene-census.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 处理单细胞测序的注释矩阵数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常处理单细胞测序的.h5ad文件
copy.tagline_en: Process annotated matrices for single-cell analysis
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with .h5ad files in single-cell research

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以创建、读取、修改和保存 AnnData 对象（单细胞分析中的注释数据矩阵），包括处理 .h5ad 和 .zarr 文件，以及进行数据子集、合并等操作。
howto.when: 当你需要处理单细胞 RNA-seq 数据、操作 .h5ad 文件，或与 scanpy、scvi-tools 等 scverse 生态工具集成时触发。

say.text: 帮我读取这个 .h5ad 文件，并显示前5行数据。
将两个 AnnData 对象按观测轴合并，并标记批次来源。
say.note: Claude 会使用 ad.concat 进行合并。

say.text: 从 AnnData 对象中筛选出质量评分大于0.8的细胞。
say.note: Claude 会基于 obs 条件进行子集操作。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create, read, modify, and save AnnData objects (annotated data matrices for single-cell analysis), including handling .h5ad and .zarr files, subsetting, merging, and other data operations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to work with single-cell RNA-seq data, manipulate .h5ad files, or integrate with scverse ecosystem tools like scanpy and scvi-tools.

say_en.text: Read this .h5ad file and show the first 5 rows of data.
say_en.note: Claude will use anndata to read the file and display the obs header.

say_en.text: Concatenate two AnnData objects along observations and label batch sources.
say_en.note: Claude will use ad.concat for merging.

say_en.text: Filter cells with quality score > 0.8 from the AnnData object.
say_en.note: Claude will subset based on obs conditions.
